@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Hypothesis.** The second-quarter dip looks the same for every
    carrier type. Outcome: each carrier type's Q2 shipments fall from
    2023 to 2024 by a percentage within 5 points of the overall fall
    (44 of 159, or 27.7%).
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def dip_by_carrier_type(pl, shipments):
    _year = pl.col('ship_date').dt.year()
    _q2 = (
        shipments.filter(pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2))
        .group_by('carrier_type')
        .agg(
            q2_2023=_year.eq(2023).sum().cast(pl.Int64),
            q2_2024=_year.eq(2024).sum().cast(pl.Int64),
        )
        .with_columns(drop=pl.col('q2_2023').sub(pl.col('q2_2024')))
        .with_columns(
            pct_change=pl.col('q2_2024')
            .truediv(pl.col('q2_2023'))
            .sub(1)
            .mul(100)
            .round(1),
            share_of_drop=pl.col('drop').truediv(pl.col('drop').sum()).round(3),
        )
        .sort('pct_change')
        .collect()
    )
    _q2
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** Tanker Q2 shipments fell from 23 to 13, a drop of 10
    (−43.5%, 23% of the total drop). Container fell from 92 to 66, a drop
    of 26 (−28.3%, 59%). Bulk fell from 44 to 36, a drop of 8 (−18.2%,
    18%). The overall fall is 44 of 159 (−27.7%). The spread between
    carrier types runs from −18.2% to −43.5%, about 25 points.
    """)
    return
